blurb: New York Harbor Tours offers private and small group boat tours around New York Harbor and Manhattan. Guests see landmarks like the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Ellis Island, and the Manhattan skyline. Tours are intimate, with boats seating 6 or 16 guests, and include options for corporate events, family outings, and special occasions.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled more than 7 days prior; deposit kept as credit if cancelled less than 7 days prior; full deposit lost if cancelled less than 48 hours prior · No tours in unsafe weather; boat has enclosed cabin and rain gear available · Tobacco allowed on private tours; marijuana prohibited due to federal regulations · Typically depart from Pier 25 in Lower Manhattan; additional pickup locations available depending on event needs. · Spring through fall, with special events in summer and fall

quotes.author: Lindsey Olbrecht
quotes.text: My coworkers and I took the sunset private cruise with Captain Joel. We had an amazing time. The company was very flexible with our crazy schedules and even worked with weather concerns occurring day of the ride. The boat was perfect for our party of 4 with room to spare. It was easy to bring food and drinks for the trip with a cooler on board. The ride was smooth and we were able to see of few of our favorite NY spots from the water. We can’t wait to book again in the spring!

quotes.author: Brandie Head-Townsend
quotes.text: We had a great time on the Tireless! Dave & his co-captain were amazing! They were very knowledgeable about the city and very engaging! This private boating tour is definitely the best option to see NYC up close and personal! Great experience!

This experience is amazing! My husband and I have lived in NYC for 10 years, but we’ve never seen it like this.For our 10-year anniversary, we chartered the Tireless with Captain David. We brought our own snacks and beverages and relaxed as we watched the city and sights go by.David is super cool and friendly without being overbearing. You can tell he really loved sharing this precious vantage point from the water with us.The boat was spotless and super comfortable. And there was no worry re COVID. Everything felt super safe.We highly recommend this - for tourists and locals alike!

Don’t think twice about booking this trip. David made our experience special and worthwhile. We had so much fun that day. He really was an amazing host and enjoys what he does. Most importantly, he values safety which is important! We definitely plan booking with David again for future birthdays and while having friends and family in town.
